options.label: dragon head, long neck, folded wings

Replace the warrior with a completely new character who stands in the same upright pose, in the same spot with his feet on the same line, at the same height, in the same three quarter view facing down-left, drawn in the same crisp detailed dark fantasy pixel art style with the same pixel size, dark outlines and light from the upper left. His long spear becomes a tall war banner. Nothing of the old warrior remains: no human skin, no war paint, no hair, no fur mantle, no bone crown. He is one of the Sovereign's hunters, their standard bearer: a very good looking, goth looking reptilian dragonkin, proud and elegant, standing tall. Fine dark scales, two small short horns swept back, and two thin flaps of skin hanging down on either side of the chin like a goatee. Mouth closed, calm cold eyes. He wears fitted ornate gothic body armour. His front hand grips the tall pole of a war banner planted upright beside him, the flag hanging high above his head; his other arm carries a shield. Head and body: a sleek dragon head with a short narrow snout on a long graceful neck, a pair of dark wings folded tight against his back, a long tail. Colours: black scales with a pale silver sheen on the jaw and throat, black gothic armour with silver edges, a long black cape with a blood red lining, a blood red banner with a black sigil, a black shield with a silver rim. Full body and the whole banner inside the image with clear margins. One character only. Plain flat uniform blue grey (#56616c) background, no floor, no shadow, no text.
